[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Logistics is an advanced logistics mod that links chests, machines, and farms together in one unified network with advanced automation features. [/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]View this mod's [url=https://github.com/chocomint02/stardew-logistics-mod]Github[/url] for detailed information.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52991/52991-1790506757-1730072164.png[/img][/color][/size]

[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/size][/color][/*]
[*]Download this mod from the NexusMods downloads page or [url=https://github.com/chocomint02/stardew-logistics-mod/releases/tag/Release]Github[/url][/*]
[*]Unzip and move into your Stardew Valley installation path under [font=Courier New]\Mods[/font][/*]
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52991/52991-1790507042-1109131141.png[/img]

Configuration can be done through this mod's [font=Courier New]config.json [font=Arial]file or through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM.[/url][/font][/font]
